title: AI Passed QA. Human Hated It.

direction.name: Forensic Deadpan
direction.visual_spine: Actual source footage, dark editorial canvas, paper-white type, green machine-pass signal, coral human-review tension, fixed reading axes, no simulated UI.

references.borrow: Immediate artifact, compressed state changes, and decisive editorial pacing.
references.avoid: Copied UI or audio, unsupported claims, and presenting any recreation as a live capture.

references.borrow: A specific lived story and a recognizable human point of view.
references.avoid: Manufactured creator persona and generic trend imitation.

scenes.title: The machine passes its own work
scenes.purpose: Establish the real artifact and verified delivery checks before human judgment enters.
scenes.entry_visual: Actual source video plus PASSED QA and Aaron identity visible at frame zero.
scenes.music_cue: Confident restrained documentary opening under narration.

scenes.title: The human watches
scenes.purpose: Give the human-review pivot room to land before revealing the verdict.
scenes.entry_visual: THEN THE HUMAN WATCHED IT already owns the frame.
scenes.music_cue: Near-silence and one awkward low harmonic.

scenes.title: The human verdict
scenes.purpose: Present the approved feedback as the evidence the checklist could not measure.
scenes.entry_visual: The complete first feedback line is already readable at the spoken quote.
scenes.music_cue: Near-silence with one dry tonal detail after the second line.

scenes.title: The verdict changes
scenes.purpose: Compress the complete argument into one semantic contrast.
scenes.entry_visual: QA: PASSED · SHIP: BLOCKED is readable on a quiet stage.
scenes.music_cue: Dry muted pluck lands on HUMANLY WRONG.

scenes.title: The missing release gates
scenes.purpose: Convert the joke into a repeatable operating model.
scenes.entry_visual: TASTE, TRUST, and TRUTH are visible as an equal muted scaffold.

scenes.title: Human review required
scenes.purpose: Close with one quotable release rule and the series identity.
scenes.entry_visual: The complete rule and HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED mark are readable immediately.
content: If only the machine likes it, it doesn't ship.
scenes.music_cue: One dry low pluck and final silence.
